content.body: we do try to prioritize PRs for proposals that are going to stage 3

though the problem is not just the backlog, it's more that most of us have very limited time to spend on reviews, and most proposals generally mean large test262 PRs that are too big to do in one sitting

I think it's helpful when PR authors mention how they validated the tests (e.g. polyfill, esmeta, in-progress engine implementation), and also helpful when potentially tricky areas of the PR are highlighted in advance
Ah see I didn't want to go go on the agenda until review had happened -- sounds like I had that backwards
I don't know if it's backwards? maybe I should've said "proposals that would like to go to stage 3" 😄
But yes, I know time is definitely an issue, so I want to smooth things as much as I can, and provide labour if it helps :)
also helps when PRs are not huge, but yours is not _that_ big anyway, so I don't know if it would make sense to split up into multiple topics
